note: Flat faces of the Nezu bo (KIT.md § Flat faces). Two photographs, an oval bell: each face is a chord plane seen down its photograph's own line of sight (the crown: its own plane); the points are exact points of that plane projected through the camera fitted to both photographs together (dossier §b.1), so the camera solve stands in for hand-read landmarks. Scale is inferred (dossier §b.3). dev-*.jpg beside them are the same photographs DEVELOPED onto the half-face panel (x = panel mm from the face's centre line, angle-proportional; y = body mm), ruled every 10 mm: the images the décor was traced from.
